title: La Dolce Vita Sandpiper Vacation Rentals
meta_description: NatureWalk at Seagrove offers La Dolce Vita, a custom 4-bedroom home with unique architectural features, tower, 3 master suites, and more!
description_expanded: **SNOWBIRD PROMOTION- Save 50% PER NIGHT January and February for monthly stays!** HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - ACCESS TO THE PUBLIC WIDE BEACH (OR PRIVATE FOR MAIN TOWNS) WITH NO RESTRICTIONS. -6 seater Lithium battery golf cart** - Short walk to the community pool and nature trails - 2 adult sized beach cruisers included - Private propane grill - Fully stocked kitchen - Smart TV's in each bedroom and living room (No cable-streaming services only) - Sandpiper Linen Program Participant: All linen, bedding and bath, are the highest quality. OPTIONAL ADD-ONS: **Optional Cancellation Protection**- Allows cancellation for ANY reason up to 48 hours in advance of stay and guarantees 50% of all monies paid returned ($150 fee applies at booking). **Use of Owner Golf Cart with $1000 refundable security deposit and signed waiver AMAZING location within Naturewalk. One of the first houses giving you easy access to Publix and 30A! Custom Built 3-story house on Corner Lot with two spacious living areas on first and second levels. With an eat-in Kitchen with arched openings to living-dining area, this home is perfect for entertaining, including large side porch off kitchen for outdoor dining and relaxing or enjoy cool evenings in front of the gas fireplace in living area. All four bedrooms are en-suite, with large master suite on the second floor. The King Master suite has a morning coffee area; large master bath has whirlpool tub with oversized separate beautiful, tiled shower. Outstanding view from third level sitting area surrounded by glass. This custom beautifully designed house has many unique features such as ten-foot doors, arched openings on first level; exceptional tile in all baths, wood ceilings on the first floor, guest powder room on first level, covered front porch; large open side porch, balconies on second level including master suite; separate areas on all three levels for relaxing or reading. Plenty of parking behind two car closed garage with two beautiful wood doors at rear of house. Nature view across street. NatureWalk is a beautiful subdivision with exercise trails, volleyball and tennis courts, playground, pools, and lounge areas. ACCOMMODATIONS: (sleeps 10): First floor: Bedroom 1:King bed, Flat screen TV, ensuite full bathroom with tub/shower combo Second Floor: Bedroom 2: Bunk room sleeps 4 (all twin beds), Flat screen TV, ensuite bathroom with tub/shower combo Bedroom 3: King bed, Flat screen TV, ensuite full bathroom tub/shower combo Bedroom 4: King bed, Flat screen TV, ensuite full bathroom with whirlpool tub with oversized separate beautiful, tiled shower ** 2022 6-seater Golf Cart ($1000 refundable deposit required to use)- Please note this amount is not included in initial booking. Must be 25 years of age to drive this golf cart. ** Please be aware that Black Bears frequent the Naturewalk community** ** Please note the Naturewalk community requires 7-night rentals year-round** ** FREE WIFI

Amenities: High touch surfaces cleaned with disinfectant
Towels and bedding washed in water that's at least 60sC/140sF
